messages:
olga: Need to request Azure quota + capacity reservation for a POC next week. Region: westeurope. We need ND40rs_v2 x8 and NC24rs_v3 x4 for ~2 weeks. Also check subnet IP quota and Accelerated Networking on the target VNET. Who can open the cases and track?
kevin: Which subscription id? and exact start date?
olga: sub: 47a9-REDACTED-32fc (I can DM full ID). Start: 2026-03-25, but we'd like the capacity guaranteed by 03/23 for staging.
maria: I can open the quota and capacity cases. Azure usually needs the subscription + justification + expected vCPUs/GPU families. I'll open a Support case for quotas and a Capacity Reservation request with TAM.
raj: FYI run this to list current GPU quotas: ```az vm list-usage --location westeurope --subscription <SUB_ID> --output table``` and grep for GPU SKUs. For Accelerated Networking check NIC SKU + distro.
kevin: Also confirm IPs: subnet /24 might be tight if we spin many nodes. We should request a subnet increase or additional IP range.
sarah: Cost question — will these live in Dedicated/reserved pool or PAID? If we reserve, commit window?
maria: For this POC we'll do short-term capacity reservation via the Azure quota/capacity team (they typically provision a tenant reservation), it's billed pay-as-you-go unless we convert to a reserved SKU. I'll ask billing owner to confirm chargeback.
maria: Opened SR: SR#20260325-9983 (quota) — case link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/selectedCaseId/SR20260325-9983 (internal link). Added justification and target date 2026-03-23.
maria: Also opened Capacity request ticket with TAM: CAP#AZ-CR-71829 — they asked for the same SKU list and staging dates.
infra-bot: Support SR SR#20260325-9983 updated -> 'Needs more info' (timestamp 1792005000)
olga: What info do they need?
maria: They want the exact VM size names and the manifest of expected concurrent VMs, plus the network subscription ID. I pasted the pod manifest and a rough scale plan.
kevin: can we also pre-create the subnet with /22 and request peering with the reserved cluster? ops-sre can handle infra changes.
raj: I'll pre-check current allocations: we have 12 ND40rs_v2 available globally but only 2 in westeurope right now.
sarah: If Azure can't fulfill all ND40rs_v2, can we fallback to ND96asr_v4 or split across regions?
maria: TAM said ND96asr_v4 not compatible with our image right now; fallback to NC24rs_v3 is possible but needs kernel tweak. I'll add that to the case.
maria: Updated SR comment: requested accelerated networking verification, subnet CIDR, and validation of capacity reservation.
infra-bot: CAP#AZ-CR-71829 status -> 'Provisioning' (timestamp 1792007200)
olga: thanks — please ping when CAP goes green. Also I added a tracker row: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/infra/gpu-capacity-tracker (please update with ticket numbers)
kevin: I'll add the cost estimate row (approx $/hour) and a note about fallbacks.
maria: CAP now shows 'Ready' for 8x ND40rs_v2 and 4x NC24rs_v3 in westeurope, expires 2026-04-07. CAP#AZ-CR-71829.
infra-bot: SR#20260325-9983 -> 'Resolved' (timestamp 1792008600)
olga: Amazing — can someone confirm VM images boot and kernel modules for NC24rs_v3?
raj: I'll do a quick smoke test tomorrow and post results.
kevin: schedule smoke test 03/20 09:00 UTC.
raj: smoke test done: booted 1x ND40rs_v2 and 1x NC24rs_v3, nv_peer_memory and nv_peer_detect loaded, network perf looks ok, IPs fine. Logs: ```dmesg | tail -n 20``` showed no errors.
olga: Great, closing the loop. Updated tracker with SR and CAP numbers. :tada:
